title: ClaimedRoot fixture drops its state while detached check-capture workers still run in its worktree, so the temp root is not removed
outcome: ClaimedRoot tests no longer leave a capture worker (basis snapshot or toolchain probe) running in the fixture worktree when their temp root is dropped, so the root and its owner marker are always removed.
acceptance: A deterministic witness first fails on the unmodified fixture: with one of the fixture session's capture workers held running, the ClaimedRoot fixture's teardown removes its temporary root before that worker finishes.

The fix changes only test fixtures: ClaimedRoot settles every capture worker its session started (its capture_workers count reaches zero) before its state drops, failing a hung worker by a watchdog, and gives the checks it starts the fixture toolchain label so no host rustup runs; product capture, its worker limit and its real-path tests are unchanged.
The full five-stage gate passes on the combined input with no run-root leftover attributed to these tests; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.

completion.summary: The ClaimedRoot fixture settles every capture worker its session started before its state drops (a watchdog fails a hung one), and gives its checks the fixture toolchain label so no host rustup runs.
